properties.displayName: UAV S26 - mavlink-router Unauthorized Endpoint (Rogue C2 Relay)
properties.description: mavlink-router에 비인가 엔드포인트가 추가되어 MsgTx가 비정상적으로 증가하는 패턴 탐지. 실제 컬럼: EndpointName, PeerIp(UAVId 없음). MITRE: T1090 Proxy (ICS — description 참조)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let knownEndpoints = dynamic(["gcs-primary","telemetry-tap","sat-modem","qgc-local"]);
let KnownGCS = _GetWatchlist('C2_Whitelisted_GCS_List') | project GCS_IP;
UAVRouterStats_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| extend isUnknownEndpoint = EndpointName !in (knownEndpoints)
| extend isUnknownPeer = PeerIp !in (KnownGCS)
| where isUnknownEndpoint or isUnknownPeer
| summarize MsgTxTotal=sum(MsgTx), MsgRxTotal=sum(MsgRx), FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated)
    by EndpointName, PeerIp, PeerPort
| extend TriggerReason = strcat("mavlink-router_비인가_엔드포인트_", EndpointName, "_PeerIp:", PeerIp)
| extend Severity = "High"
| project FirstSeen, EndpointName, PeerIp, PeerPort, MsgTxTotal, MsgRxTotal, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by FirstSeen desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S26 - mavlink-router Unauthorized Endpoint (Rogue C2 Relay) - {{PeerIp}}
